# Bhadeya Technical Services LLC

> UAE specialist in GPR (Ground Penetrating Radar) scanning, diamond core cutting, excavation, and interlock and road pavement services. Founded 2019, based in Dubai, operating across all 6 UAE Emirates. Trusted by Dubai Mall, Emaar, ADNOC, Kempinski, and Sheikh Khalifa Hospital.

## Services

- GPR Concrete Scanning (Proceq GP8000): https://www.bhadeya.com/services/gpr-scanning
- GPR Ground Scanning / underground utility locating (Proceq GS8000): https://www.bhadeya.com/services/gs8000-scanning
- GPR Scanning Dubai (landing page): https://www.bhadeya.com/gpr-scanning-dubai
- Core Cutting: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/core-cutting
- Excavation: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/excavation
- Interlock & Road Pavement: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/interlock-road-pavement
- Oversized Cargo Movement: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/oversized-cargo

## Key Facts

- Equipment: Proceq GP8000 (concrete scanning, up to 1m depth in concrete)
- Equipment: Proceq GS8000 (ground scanning, 3–5m in soil depending on ground conditions)
- Scanning depth in concrete: 1m. Scanning depth in ground for excavation: 3–5m, soil-dependent
- GPR scanning is performed before every excavation job
- GPR accuracy: ±10mm under ideal conditions
- Core cutting diameter range: 12mm to 500mm
- Founded: 2019 — 7+ years experience
- Projects completed: 500+
- Service area: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Al Ain (all UAE)
- Business hours: Sun–Thu 8AM–6PM, Sat 9AM–3PM (UAE time)
- Contact: +971 55 692 6286
